verdict.rationale: The only multimodal evidence is that Helicone's AI Gateway supports image generation, and gateway traffic is automatically logged. That only implies generated images may show up in request logs; no evidence explicitly describes capturing or rendering image, audio, or file payloads inside traces. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multimodal payload capture in traces or sessions, audio and file input support, rendering of image inputs in the trace UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
